items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: A guy named Jimmy Mosher was with him too. And Buddy’d get so mad he’d throw the sticks at him. But Jimmy always had a funny line, a funny comeback, and nothing he could do you know. They were funny guys man.

ctx.x: That’s interesting. I didn’t know anybody had the nerve to try to top Buddy Rich.

Oh yeah. A guy named Jimmy Mosher was with him too. And Buddy’d get so mad he’d throw the sticks at him. But Jimmy always had a funny line, a funny comeback, and nothing he could do you know. They were funny guys man.
Oh, man, you played with SuperSax?
